limits: The free plan shows WordPress.com ads to visitors

summary: The hosted version of WordPress: free to publish, ads included, no AI builder in the sense the rest of this site means.

payments.detail: Payments need WooCommerce on a paid plan (checked on the pricing page)

custom_domain.detail: Custom domain requires a paid plan; free sites keep a wordpress.com address and show WordPress.com ads

run_blocker: No AI prompt on the free plan: the setup flow ends in a theme picker (/setup/site-setup/design-setup), there is no site generator. A same-brief run would measure the operator (checked 15.11.2026).

no_ai.reason: No site generator on the free plan: the setup ends in a theme picker, content is written and placed by hand.
